description: Email validation, email verification, disposable email check. Check an email address without sending anything: is the format valid, does the domain exist and accept mail (MX records), is it a known throwaway/disposable provider, is it a role address (info@, admin@...) or a free webmail provider. The address is not stored or logged, and no email is ever sent. Price: $0.001 per call (x402, USDC on Base).
name: email_check
